verdict.rationale: Vercel ships agent-facing 'skills' and slash commands so coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) can drive deployments and framework tasks via natural language, and allows AI agents to deploy projects and hand off to a human — evidence of AI-native operability rather than a full built-in NL interface. This relies on third-party coding agents/CLIs rather than a native conversational control surface for the whole platform (dashboard, env vars, domains, etc.). Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party natural-language interface covering the full product surface, and independent hands-on validation that these agent skills reliably execute complex operations.
